diagnosis.conclusion: The rendering adapter conflates a serialized palette reference with the effective native per-tile Variation owner. That invariant is invalid when the source palette alias resolves NULL and native loading carries the preceding successful Variation. The existing guard correctly refuses the lossy representation; deleting the guard or picking one identity would corrupt material selection.
